newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH BAAN LAUNCHES NEW SOFTWARE PRODUCT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH BAAN LAUNCHES NEW SOFTWARE PRODUCT.

text.p: Dutch business software company Baan Co NV said on Friday it had introduced a new product, Baan Synchronization.
The company said the new product extended BAAN IV, the product which ties together all aspects of a business, such as organisational structures, manufacturing, logistics and finance.
Baan said Baan Synchronization synchronised individual plant and supplier operations and provided detailed schedules of plant resources including staff, equipment, tools and materials.
It is being shipped today to customers including KLM, Ready Bake Foods and British Aerospace .
